originals.why: Moved from seed 639. It is the seed sentence itself, so it is natural here and uses be' ddudoch chi in the taught sense.

originals.ko: 실례지만, 저는 노력하고 있어요, 하지만 뭐라고 말씀하셨어요?
originals.why: Moved from seed 639. 'I'm trying, but what did you say?' is natural North Welsh, and ond + be' ddudoch chi is grammatical.

originals.ko: 실례지만, 뭐라고 말씀하셨어요? 저는 감히 하지 않았을 거예요.
originals.why: Moved from seed 639. 'What did you say? I wouldn't have dared' is an idiomatic indignant reply, and the LEGO keeps its taught sense.

originals.ko: 실례지만, 뭐라고 말씀하셨어요? 저는 믿기가 어려워요.
실례지만, 당시에 뭐라고 말씀하셨어요? 저는 확실히 할 필요가 있어요.
실례지만, 어젯밤에 뭐라고 말씀하셨어요? 저는 알아내고 싶어요.
